Messages.Author: Carsten Raufuss
Messages.Body:
I've got a question that arose lately during one of our group's games.
You have got two vampires out. Gilbert Douane (with Haven Uncovered) and
Mariel (tapped). A Brujah comes up and attacks Gilbert Douane due to Haven
Uncovered. Is it possible for the Malkavian player to Wake with Evenings
Freshness his Mariel and then tap her to end any combat (and in this case
prevent the Brujah from attacking Gilbert Douane)?

--
Carsten Raufuss (magi...@wombaz.robin.de)

Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Carsten Raufuss (magi...@wombaz.robin.de) wrote:
: I've got a question that arose lately during one of our group's games.


Definitely not. WWEF allows a vampire to '...play reaction cards and
attempt to block as though untapped....' It does _not_ allow a vampire
to untap, and thus Mariel is unable to use her special ability.

Side comment: Were the acting vampire attempting to bleed you instead of
attempting to attack Gilbert, AND if you had given Mariel an Animalism
Master/Skill card, it would be perfectly legal to use a Rat's warning to
untap Mariel (since you are being bled), block with Gilbert, then re-tap
Mariel to end combat.

Messages.Author: Eric Pettersen
Messages.Body:
Can the damage caused by tapping Mariel be prevented by a Flak
Jacket? If so, how about Fortitude damage prevention and/or Sideslip?
While I'm at it, can Mariel (or Elysium for that matter) be tapped at the
beginning of later rounds of combat?

Messages.Author: Murphy Christopher J
Messages.Body:
Eric Pettersen (pe...@homer.ucsf.edu.ucsf.edu) wrote:
: Can the damage caused by tapping Mariel be prevented by a Flak


Flak Jckts prevent damage during a combat in the damage resolution
phase. Mariel's ability ends the combat -> no damage resolution phase
and then causes damage to both combatants -> not combat inflicted.

Hence Flak Jckts, Fortitude, Sideslip cannot be used to prevent the damage.

The Anti-Chris(t)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:





Flak Jackets and Fortitude cards prevent 1 damage per combat.
Since this damage normally occurs during damage resolution, that is
normally when they are applied. But they can be used at any point in
the combat, including the point at which Mariel deals her damage.
(Or the point at which the spawning pool does its damage).

They cannot be used for non-combat damage (Talbot's Chainsaw, e.g.)

Mariels damage is combat inflicted. (Tap to end combat and deal damage, not
Tap to end combat and then deal damage).
